title: Knowledge graph L2: Digital Adaptation Kit
description: The kit itself. Properties are exactly the metadata fields DAK.fsh declares and dak.json carries -- no more, so that a dak node can be produced from a real file without anything being invented. canonicalUrl equals publicationUrl on a release branch and previewUrl on a development branch, per DAK.fsh. Both are kept because which one canonicalUrl currently equals is what says whether a graph describes a release or a build. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/dak.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for KGDak logical model

@context.description: JSON-LD context for this logical model with ValueSet vocabularies

anyOf.description: URI reference to external JSON-LD context

@type.description: JSON-LD type identifier for KGDak logical model

id.description: The identifier the source declares (an FSH instance id, a BPMN or DMN element id).

name.description: The computable name: the CamelCase identifier a Canonical() reference matches on.

description.description: A description, as the source gives it.

status.description: The DAK's publication status (DAK.fsh, FHIR PublicationStatus).

previewUrl.description: Where the development build is previewed (DAK.fsh).

canonicalUrl.description: The canonical base; equals publicationUrl on a release branch and previewUrl on a development branch.

license.description: The licence, as DAK.fsh declares it (an SPDX code).

copyrightYear.description: The copyright year or range, as declared.
